FACILITY 01

Advanced Modular Operation Theaters (OT)

Ultra-sterile laminar airflow modular OTs equipped for robotic joint replacements, complex neurosurgery, and infection-free surgical procedures.

Vertical Laminar Airflow

Continuous positive pressure vertical airflow system delivering HEPA-filtered sterile air to prevent intraoperative infection.

Robotic & Joint Replacement Suite

Specialized surgical suites configured for robotic-assisted joint replacements and complex revision surgeries.

Digital Intraoperative Fluoroscopy

Real-time C-Arm fluoroscopic guidance ensuring precise bone alignment and accurate custom implant positioning.

FACILITY 02

Fully Equipped Intensive Care Unit (ICU)

24/7 dedicated ICU monitoring with advanced ventilators, multipara cardiac monitors, and round-the-clock critical care specialists.

24/7 Critical Care Specialists

Attended continuously by qualified critical care physicians and experienced ICU nurses for immediate intervention.

Advanced Mechanical Ventilation

High-grade respiratory ventilators and centralized medical oxygen pipeline infrastructure at every bedside.

Continuous Telemetry & Multipara Monitoring

Real-time multiparameter bedside monitoring tracking cardiac rhythm, SpO2, and blood pressure 24 hours a day.

FACILITY 03

State-of-the-Art Surgical Infrastructure

High-precision surgical instruments, digital C-arm imaging, micro-endoscopic spinal systems, and advanced arthroscopic towers.

Digital C-Arm System

Intraoperative fluoroscopy for precision bone alignment and fracture fixation.

Micro-Endoscopic Spinal Suite

Specialized endoscopic instruments for targeted spinal nerve decompression.

Precision Power Tools

High-torque orthopaedic power instruments for exact, clean surgical bone cuts.

Radiolucent Trauma Setup

Carbon-fiber surgical tables facilitating multi-angle intraoperative X-ray imaging.

FACILITY 04

24×7 Emergency & Trauma Care

Round-the-clock emergency polytrauma stabilization, complex fracture management, and immediate life-saving medical intervention.

Immediate Polytrauma Triage

Dedicated emergency bay structured for rapid assessment, resuscitation, and multi-system trauma stabilization.

24/7 On-Call Trauma Specialists

Expert orthopaedic and neurosurgical trauma teams on stand-by day and night for emergency surgical procedures.

Closed Reduction & Immobilization

Emergency room equipment for immediate fracture realignment, casting, and acute dislocation care.

FACILITY 05

Modern Diagnostic & Patient Care Facilities

In-house high-resolution digital X-ray, clinical laboratory diagnostics, and 40 comfortable inpatient beds designed for patient recovery.

In-House Digital Diagnostics & Lab

Low-dose digital radiography and full clinical laboratory testing for rapid pre-operative evaluation and diagnostic precision.

40 Inpatient Beds

Private suites and semi-private recovery rooms equipped with motorized adjustable beds, nurse call alerts, and uninterrupted power backup.

FACILITY 06

Comprehensive Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation

Customized post-operative physical therapy, gait retraining, athletic rehabilitation, and pain management under expert guidance.

Surgeon-Guided Rehabilitation Protocols

Physical therapy programs developed directly alongside operating surgeons for optimal joint healing and functional recovery.

Gait Retraining & Balance Equipment

Parallel walking bars and posture retraining apparatus supporting safe, confident early walking after surgery.

Advanced Electrotherapy Modalities

TENS, IFT, ultrasonic therapy, and heat modalities providing non-invasive targeted post-op pain management.

Committed to delivering compassionate, world-class orthopaedic healthcare to every patient, every day.
